item.title: Top 4 Steps to Customize MudBlazor Components - Change Font Size with Ease
item.description:
Customizing MudBlazor components can significantly enhance your application’s appearance and user experience. This post provides a deep dive into the top four steps to modify the font size of the MudSelect component. Whether you’re new to Blazor or an experienced developer, this guide will help you apply precise customizations to your components.

Top 4 Steps to Customize MudBlazor Components - Change Font Size with Ease

Step 1: Identify the Target CSS Class

The first step in customizing any MudBlazor component is identifying the relevant CSS class. For the MudSelect component, you’ll need to target the .mud-select-input class, which controls the text displayed after selection.
